court_name: Superior Court of California, County of San Diego
case_search_note: Online Case Search – Court Index (linked from sdcourt.ca.gov Online Case Search page). Search by party name, court case number, or DA case number for criminal cases. Gives case number and location only. Juvenile, Traffic/Minor Offense, and pre-1974 cases are NOT in the index; misdemeanor records may be available only for 10 years at some locations.

courthouses.name: Central Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Criminal business office Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m. (excluding court holidays): 1st floor felonies, 2nd floor misdemeanors & Substance Abuse Assessment Unit, 14th floor older records
courthouses.note: Court page: full-service facility for criminal (felonies, misdemeanors), probate, family court, appeals and administration. Criminal bail bonds & collections: (619) 450-7034. Many business office phones answered 8:30–11:30 a.m. Mon–Fri. Arraignment location not stated on the page.

courthouses.name: Hall of Justice
courthouses.note: Civil independent calendar courtrooms, Civil Business Office and Small Claims. Court page does not list criminal courtrooms here (the DA's office and Probation's Central Division are in the building). Phone listed is the Civil Business Office.

courthouses.name: North County Regional Center
courthouses.hours: Criminal business office Suite 500, 1st floor, Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m. (excluding court holidays)
courthouses.note: Court page: hears Criminal, Civil, Family Law, Appeals, Adoption, Traffic and Minor Offense cases. Traffic (Minor Offenses): (760) 201-8500. Vista Detention Facility is at the same address (Suite 200).

programs.name: Adult Drug Court
programs.summary: For selected non-violent felony and misdemeanor drug cases: frequent random testing, judicial supervision, treatment, education/vocational help, sanctions and incentives. Minimum 18 months; on completion probation may be terminated or, rarely, the drug charge dismissed on the prosecutor's recommendation. Four divisions: North County, Central, East County, South County. Participants pay $20/week to the treatment provider. Excludes violent, sex, manufacturing and other serious offenses.

programs.name: DUI / Substance Abuse information
programs.summary: Court's Substance Abuse – DUI pages; the Central Courthouse 2nd floor houses the Substance Abuse Assessment Unit with misdemeanors.

programs.name: SDSC Self-Help Center

programs.name: Criminal out-of-custody hearings — remote appearance
programs.summary: Court may allow in-person or remote appearances. In person: arrive 30 minutes early and go to the assigned courtroom. Remote: video via Microsoft Teams (or Zoom when posted) using the department links on the court page.

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' — check a bail agent's license status before signing anything. SD Sheriff posts a licensed bail agency list in all detention facilities and on its Jail Information page, and says it does not endorse any bail agency; it also links 'Tips to Avoid Bail Agent Scams'. Court criminal bail bonds & collections line (Central): (619) 450-7034.
